title: Optimal Order Placement under a State-Dependent Hawkes Process Limit Order Book model
abstract: arXiv:2610.37324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study optimal quote placement for a market maker facing order flow modeled by a state-dependent Hawkes process. A block-based linear demand specification links market-order counts to execution volumes, providing the demand moments required by a continuous time discrete state dynamic programming formulation. Under a quadratic terminal inventory penalty, we characterize inventory-dependent quotes and derive backward recursions for the coefficients of a quadratic value function. Numerical experiments using LOBSTER data examine quote distributions, inventory exposure, and terminal wealth. The implemented strategy yields higher aggregate terminal wealth than fixed-spread benchmarks at one and three ticks, but lower wealth than the two-tick benchmark. These results illustrate the framework's numerical implementation and distinguish terminal-wealth comparisons from evaluation under the inventory-penalized objective.

translated_title: 状态依赖Hawkes过程限价订单簿模型下的最优订单放置
translated_abstract: 我们研究做市商在面对以状态依赖Hawkes过程建模的订单流时的最优报价放置问题。一种基于分块的线性需求设定将市价单数量与成交量联系起来，为连续时间离散状态的动态规划公式提供了所需的需求矩。在二次型终端库存惩罚下，我们刻画了依赖库存状态的报价，并推导出二次价值函数系数的后向递推公式。基于LOBSTER数据的数值实验考察了报价分布、库存风险敞口和终端财富。所实施的策略在一档和三档固定价差基准下产生更高的总终端财富，但低于两档基准的财富。这些结果展示了该框架的数值实现，并区分了终端财富比较与库存惩罚目标下的评估。
tldr: 提出了一个基于状态依赖Hawkes过程限价订单簿模型的做市商最优报价放置框架，通过分块线性需求设定与动态规划递推刻画库存依赖的报价策略，并在真实数据实验中验证了其终端财富表现。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an optimal quote placement framework for market makers under a state-dependent Hawkes process limit order book model, using a block-based linear demand specification and dynamic programming recursions to characterize inventory-dependent quotes, with numerical experiments on LOBSTER data validating its terminal wealth performance.
